# Third-party notices

CS2SJ Demo distributes unmodified runtime files from these projects:

- HLAE / AdvancedFX 2.191.0: https://github.com/advancedfx/advancedfx
- AfxHookSource2: included with the official HLAE release.
- FFmpeg 9.0.1 essentials x64 build by Gyan Doshi: https://ffmpeg.org/ and https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
